title: WaitlistCommandsAutoAcceptV1
description: Queue-only command (spec 11 §5.1, §20) crossing the broker to the waitlist consumer (consumer 'waitlist.processor'). Enqueued by the matcher when a matched slot satisfies a recorded AutoBookGrant: instructs the platform to auto-book the offer by minting an auditable spec-04 confirmed revision (carrying the grant's consent evidence, Inv-1) rather than finalizing capacity directly. Handled by a plain (non-inbox) consumer so it can open its own transaction to call spec-04; idempotent via the spec-04 key + the offer's version-guarded claim. Carries NO secrets or PII beyond opaque ids (Inv-12).

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.commands.auto_accept.v1' for this contract.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. All consumer-side writes are scoped to this tenant (Inv-13).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (typically the enrollment id).

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause (the match that scheduled the auto-book).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the waitlist_offers row to auto-book; the handler reloads it for the slot + operation id.

operation_id.description: Provisional booking operation id the offer's capacity hold was reserved against (spec 07); the spec-04 submission mints under this id so the 06 engine reuses the hold.
